examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Five solution areas under a section title and description, every picture at the closing end. Each band carries its own overline; the AI band draws a live `ConsoleMockup` scene, and the performance band links as a whole to its own `href` while its button keeps its own. Under the section title each band headline is an `h3`. Edit the props in the Controls panel — clear the `title` to drop the header.

examples.name: Product media
examples.summary: Bands whose pictures show the product itself: a ConsoleMockup console screen (`widget`), which plays its beat while the pointer is over the band, and an object picture set whole on its own plate (`imageFramed`). The widget loads only when a band uses it.

site.name: Solutions
site.summary: The five solution areas of Home: large, centered bands, every picture at the closing end, each with an outlined "Learn more" button.
